meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后,当用户要求时,Claude 会检查本地 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 的安装情况,和最新源码做对比,输出一份带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,并给出修复建议。它只读取,不会改动你的安装或配置。
howto.when: 当你说到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex,或请求健康检查,或怀疑 Codex 安装过期、损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 安装是否健康
say.note: 会生成一份带证据的通过/警告/失败报告。

say.text: 更新 Codex 后它行为怪怪的,帮我诊断下
say.note: 会对比最新源码,找出安装漂移或损坏点。

say.text: 把我的 LazyCodex 和最新版本对比一下
say.note: 会检查版本和配置是否有过期或偏离。

howto.what_en: Upon request, Claude inspects the local LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation, compares it against the latest upstream sources, and produces a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence for each verdict, plus remediation steps. It only reads and never mutates the user's install/config.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a health check, mentions LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex misbehaves after install/update/config change, or suspects a stale/broken setup.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex installation is healthy
say_en.note: Generates a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence.

say_en.text: Codex acts weird after an update; diagnose it
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources to find drift or breakage.

say_en.text: Compare my LazyCodex with the latest version
say_en.note: Checks for outdated or drifted versions and configs.
